sources.entry: geojson - Python bindings and utilities for GeoJSON.

summary.one_liner: Python library for encoding, decoding, and building GeoJSON geometry, feature, and feature-collection objects.
summary.what_it_does: Provides classes for every GeoJSON object type (Point, MultiPoint, LineString, MultiLineString, Polygon, MultiPolygon, GeometryCollection, Feature, FeatureCollection). Its dump, dumps, load, and loads functions convert these objects to and from raw GeoJSON text. Custom classes can be serialized by implementing the __geo_interface__ protocol. The geojson.utils module includes coords, which yields all coordinate tuples from a geometry or feature, and map_coords, which applies a function to every coordinate and returns a geometry of the same type. The README includes doctest-style examples for each object type.
use_cases: serialize custom classes as GeoJSON via __geo_interface__
extract all coordinates from a feature
notable: Covers all GeoJSON object types from the GeoJSON format specification
Implements the Python __geo_interface__ specification for custom classes
caveats: README states compatibility with Python 2.6, 2.7, 3.2, 3.3, and 3.4, which is dated
Build and test commands use setup.py, which the README does not say is deprecated
